把画面和含义连起来: Connect the image to its meaning
先选你看见的，再选它支持的含义。两端都可以改，想好后一起核对。: Choose what you see, then the meaning it supports. Change either choice before checking the connection.
为两张牌找回各自的含义: Return each meaning to its card
先看一眼画面，找一个让你记得住的动作。: Take a look. Find an action that will stay in your memory.
别急着认牌名。把这句话和画面里的动作对上。: Look beyond the card name. Match the words to the action in the image.
让依据和含义一起成立，比猜中一个词更有用。: A meaning is stronger when its visual evidence fits too.
答案先收起来。在心里说出来，就算一次真正的尝试。: Keep the answer hidden. Saying it in your mind is a real attempt at recall.
这两张很接近。把两句含义各自交还给它们。: These two are close. Find the meaning that belongs to each.
牌还在眼前。点一个位置，看看它在这里承担什么任务。: Keep the card in view. Tap a position to explore the role it plays there.
把逆位想成核心主题的另一种表达，再回到画面核对。: Consider a reversal as another expression of the core theme. Check it against the image.
这一笔已经记下。看清差别，再由你决定继续。: Your attempt is saved. Notice the difference, then continue when you are ready.
和这张牌第一次见面: A first encounter with this card
先看，不急着背。: Look first. No rush to memorize.
留意人物在做什么、目光朝向哪里、什么东西最突出。点牌可以放大，准备好了再打开线索: Notice the actions, the direction of attention, and what stands out. Tap the image to enlarge it. Open the clues when you are ready.
这里没有倒计时，按自己的节奏看。: No countdown. Take the time you need.
让两端彼此支持: Let both ends support each other
选择一条画面证据: Choose a piece of visual evidence
选择它最支持的含义: Choose the meaning it best supports
先选好画面这一端，再连向含义。: Choose the visual evidence first, then connect it to a meaning.
先点一句含义，再点它属于的牌。点已放好的含义可以收回。: Tap a meaning, then the card it belongs to. Tap a filled card to take its meaning back.
两句已归位。还可以点牌收回，确认后再核对。: Both meanings are placed. You can still tap a card to take one back before checking.
已拿起这句含义，再点它属于的牌。: Meaning selected. Now tap the card it belongs to.
点一句，开始配对。: Tap a meaning to begin matching.
✕ 这次还没连对: ✕ This connection is not correct yet
这是看过反馈后的巩固，保留第一次的记录，不提前延长复习间隔。: This is practice after feedback. Your first attempt stays recorded, and your review interval does not increase.
含义选对了，但所选画面不支持它。下次让两个环节一起成立。: The meaning fits, but your chosen image evidence does not support it. Aim to connect both parts.
你找到了画面，但含义还差了一步。留意动作的方向与人物的处境。: You found the visual evidence. Reconsider the meaning by noticing the direction of the action and the person's situation.
